# Draft request for Marala daily inflow records

Prepared 2026-10-23. This draft has not been sent.

Suggested recipients: WAPDA Hydrology & Water Management / Water Resources Management Directorate and IRSA's hydrological data custodian. WAPDA describes these functions on its [Water Wing page](https://wapda.gov.pk/water-wing/) and in its [2022-23 annual report](https://wapda.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Annual-Report-2022-23_compressed-latest.pdf). Use the agency's current official contact route; no recipient email is assumed here.

Subject: Request for daily Chenab inflow at Marala, 2024-12-20 through 2026-10-23, and historical reading definitions

We are preparing a research model to forecast daily Chenab discharge at Marala for each of the next 15 days from the station's earlier observations and upstream weather inputs.

Please provide a machine-readable daily Marala upstream/inflow series, including non-flood periods, for 20 December 2024 through 23 October 2026 (complete calendar year 2025 and 2026 to date). CSV or Excel is preferred. If only a partial record can be released, please state the available intervals and missing dates. Please keep outflow as a separate variable.

For the delivered data and the public WAPDA `GRAPH-DG-16-for-MAIL-2.xls` history from 2016-03-01 to 2024-12-19, please confirm:

- Station ID, location and any gauge/location or measurement-method changes.
- Whether each daily value is an instantaneous reading or a daily mean; the observation time and timezone, or the start/end of the averaging interval and the meaning of its date label.
- Whether the Marala 06:00 reading documented on 2024-12-19 applies throughout the historical series, or the periods when the convention changed.
- Units, missing-value codes, quality flags, correction status, and applicable reuse/citation terms.
- Original publication/availability times where retained, so retrospective forecasts can respect what was known at their issue time.
- Whether the numeric zero on 2021-01-23 is a valid measured flow, a missing-data code, or an error; please provide a corrected value only if supported by the station record.
- Which source values and dates are correct for the six WAPDA-FFD differences in the attached `marala_inflow_quality_review.csv`, including the FFD PDF/archive date conflicts.

Daily means reported by IRSA will be retained separately from instantaneous WAPDA/FFD readings unless their definitions and comparability are established. Original hourly or subdaily records are welcome, with timestamps and flags, if they are releasable.
